Package com.cg.training.daoImplementation

Class LibrarianDAOImplementation

java.lang.Object
com.cg.training.daoImplementation.LibrarianDAOImplementation
All Implemented Interfaces:
LibrarianDAO
public class LibrarianDAOImplementation extends Object implements LibrarianDAO
LibrarianDAOImplementation provides an in-memory implementation of the LibrarianDAO interface for managing librarian data.

This implementation stores librarian records in a list without persistence.

Author:
Jayashree Roy
